name: singlet_annotation_reference_label_transfer
title: Reference-based cell label transfer
description: Assigns each cell of a query dataset a cell-type label from a labelled reference dataset or a saved reference model, with a score and an unassigned flag per cell and optional coarser label levels. Reference and query must share gene identifiers; most methods read log-normalised values in layers/normalized, while scanvi and scarches need raw counts in layers/counts and may queue a training job. Returns method, layer_used, cell and gene counts, unassigned_fraction, score_median, levels_written, top_labels, warnings and, for celltypist_probmatch, n_multi_label_cells in summary. Do not use it to name clusters from marker genes, to discover cell types absent from the reference, or to tune thresholds on the query; it never changes counts.

dataset.description: Query dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle. Outputs are written here only.

reference.description: Labelled reference. Read-only; nothing is downloaded.

source.description: Reference dataset handle, saved reference model models/<name>, or CellTypist model file.

label_keys.description: Reference obs columns to predict, finest first; the first is the main label. Required when source is a dataset.

method.description: Transfer method. celltypist_best is the default; linear_openset is the singlet multinomial classifier with a threshold calibrated on held-out studies.

batch_key.description: Obs column naming study, donor or platform in reference and query. Used by scanvi, scarches, symphony and linear_openset; ignored by the others.

unassigned_threshold.description: Score below which a cell is unassigned. Null keeps the method default: calibrated for linear_openset, none for argmax-only methods.

features.description: Gene selection for feature-based methods; celltypist methods and singler use all shared genes.

key.description: Boolean var column present in reference and query that selects genes; overrides n_top.

n_top.description: Number of highly variable genes ranked on the reference only.

celltypist.description: Options used only when method is celltypist_best or celltypist_probmatch.

majority_voting.description: Replace each label by the dominant label of its over-cluster in cluster_key.

cluster_key.description: Query obs column of over-clusters; required when majority_voting is true.

min_prop.description: Minimum dominant fraction of a cluster; below it the cluster label is Heterogeneous.

scvi.description: Options used only when method is scanvi or scarches. Null takes the per-method default.

n_latent.description: Latent dimension; null gives 10 for scanvi and 30 for scarches.

n_layers.description: Hidden layers; null gives 1 for scanvi and 2 for scarches.

dropout_rate.description: Dropout rate; null gives 0.1 for scanvi and 0.2 for scarches.

max_epochs.description: Maximum epochs; null gives the scvi-tools epoch heuristic for scanvi and 200 with early stopping for scarches.

seed.description: Random seed for scanvi, scarches, symphony and the linear_openset folds and initialisation; recorded in uns/transfer_params_<method>.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available. scanvi and scarches training needs CUDA at atlas scale.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing members of the same method instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/transfer_label_celltypist_best. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed calls: method, layer_used, n_query_cells, n_reference_cells, n_types, n_shared_genes, n_genes_missing, levels_written, unassigned_fraction, score_median, top_labels, warnings, n_multi_label_cells. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
